summary: The Applicant accepted the Institute's recommendation to be kept informed of construction activities, and also stated that a separate archaeological survey would be conducted along the transmission line corridor where road construction and tower placement would occur.
text:
The Applicant has accepted the recommendations.
This archeological survey did not include the proposed transmission line corridor. However, Applicant has stated that a survey would be conducted along the route where road construction and tower placement would occur.
opening_anchor: The Applicant has accepted the recommendations.
closing_anchor: Applicant has stated that a survey would be conducted along the route where road construction and tower placement would occur.
